info.title: ActionStreamer API
info.description: A web API for the ActionStreamer platform.  Publish date: 2026-07-07 16:13:41 UTC

get.summary: Retrieves an individual agent based on the provided agentID.
get.description: Returns the requested agent when access is allowed.

parameters.name: agentID
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the agent to retrieve.

put.description:
Request body: JSON object. Updates selected runtime fields such as
`currentEventID`, `processID`, `agentName`, `agentDescription`, and `recentOutput`.

parameters.name: agentID
parameters.description: The ID of the agent to update.

patch.summary: Applies a patch to an agent.
patch.description:
Request body: array of patch operations. Only allows patching
`agentDescription`, `recentOutput`, `processID`, and `currentEventID`.

parameters.name: agentID
parameters.description: The ID of the agent to patch.

parameters.name: agentID
parameters.description: The ID of the agent to delete.

post.summary: Retrieves a list of agents with additional name details based on the provided filter criteria.
post.description:
Request body: JSON object.
Returns a list of agents with additional name details.

post.summary: Creates a new agent or updates an existing agent.
post.description:
This endpoint either creates a new agent or updates an existing one. It should be called at agent startup.
Request body: JSON object. Supports `deviceSerial` or `deviceName`.

get.summary: Gets the agent type list.
get.description: Returns the supported agent types.

delete the comment.

get.summary: Gets a device health record by ID.

parameters.name: deviceHealthID
parameters.description: The ID of the device health record to retrieve.

put.description:
Request body: JSON object. Updates the stored
`healthJSON` for the specified record after validating device ownership.

parameters.name: deviceHealthID
parameters.description: The ID of the device health record to update.

get.summary: Gets the latest device health record for a device.

parameters.name: deviceID
parameters.description: The ID of the device whose latest health record should be returned.

post.summary: Gets the device health list.
post.description:
Request body: JSON object. Requires
`deviceID`, converts the epoch range to dates internally, and limits the result count to 5000.
The `order` field is accepted but is not currently used.

get.summary: Gets device health rows for the authenticated user's devices.
get.description: Use the optional `status=online` query parameter to return only online devices.

post.summary: Gets line chart data for a device health variable.
post.description:
Request body: JSON object with a variable name and optional epoch range,
count, and vertical line timestamps. Returns line chart data.

parameters.name: deviceID
parameters.description: The ID of the device whose line chart data should be generated.

post.summary: Creates a device health record.
post.description:
Request body: JSON object. Accepts either
`deviceSerial` or `deviceName`. If `healthJSON.time.datetime` contains a valid epoch in
milliseconds, it is used for `healthDate`; otherwise the server uses the current UTC time.

post.summary: Updates the latest device health record for a device.
post.description:
Request body: JSON object. Updates the latest device health state and
returns the affected device health record ID.

post.summary: Dequeues the next pending event for a device agent.
post.description:
Request body: JSON object. Accepts either
`deviceSerial` or `deviceName`.

post.summary: Creates an event.
post.description:
Request body: JSON object. Supports either
`deviceSerial` or `deviceID`, either agent and event names or their numeric IDs,
and optional fields such as `serverEvent`, `eventParameters`, `priority`,
`maxAttempts`, and `expirationEpoch`.

get.summary: Gets an event by ID.
get.description:
Returns a reduced event status payload.
The response includes status details for the event.

parameters.name: eventID
parameters.description: The ID of the event to retrieve.

put.description: Request body: JSON object. Only non-null fields from the request are applied.

parameters.name: eventID
parameters.description: The ID of the event to update.

patch.description:
Request body: JSON object. Updates the
`EventStatus` field for each event ID in the `events` list for the specified device.
The device can be identified by `deviceID` or by `deviceName`.

Request body: JSON object. Patches only
`PercentComplete` for the specified event.

parameters.name: eventID
parameters.description: The ID of the event to patch.

post.summary: Gets the event list.
post.description:
Request body: JSON object. Set `deviceID` to return events
for one device, or use `deviceID = 0` to get events for the authenticated user across devices.
Supports an optional `updatedevice=true` query parameter.

post.summary: Gets the last event for a device based on agent type.
post.description:
Request body: JSON object. This endpoint follows the same
filtered event-list behavior as `GetEventListFilter`, including optional `updatedevice=true`.

parameters.name: agentTypeID
parameters.description: The agent type ID in the route.

post.summary: Get a list of pending events.
post.description:
Request body: JSON object. When `deviceName` is provided, this endpoint
returns at most one pending event for that device.
If no device is provided, server users can retrieve pending server events instead.

post.summary: Long-polls for pending events for a device.
post.description:
Request body: JSON object. This endpoint polls for up to 60 seconds and returns an
empty list if no pending events are found before the timeout.

delete.summary: Clears pending events for a device.
delete.description: Clears pending events for the specified device after authorization succeeds.

parameters.name: deviceID
parameters.description: The ID of the device whose pending events should be cleared.

post.summary: Queues an event to end the process associated with an event.

get.summary: Gets an event preset by ID.

parameters.name: eventPresetID
parameters.description: The ID of the event preset to retrieve.

put.description: Request body: JSON object.

parameters.name: eventPresetID
parameters.description: The ID of the event preset to update.

parameters.name: eventPresetID
parameters.description: The ID of the event preset to delete.

get.summary: Gets the event preset list.
get.description: Returns presets directly associated with the device and may also include presets inherited from shared device groups.

parameters.name: deviceID
parameters.description: The ID of the device whose available event presets should be returned.

post.summary: This endpoint runs a preset.
post.description:
Request body: JSON object when you want to override the target devices with a
`data` array of device IDs.

parameters.name: eventPresetID
parameters.description: The ID of the event preset to run.

post.summary: Sets the device startup event preset.
post.description: Startup presets must target a single device.

parameters.name: eventPresetID
parameters.description: The event preset ID to apply as the startup preset.

parameters.name: deviceState
parameters.description: The device startup mode. Accepted values are "online" and "standalone".

delete.summary: Deletes the device startup event preset.
delete.description: Clears the configured startup preset for the specified mode.

parameters.name: deviceState
parameters.description: The device startup mode. Accepted values are "online" and "standalone".

parameters.name: deviceID
parameters.description: The ID of the device whose startup preset should be cleared.

post.summary: Creates an event preset.
post.description:
Request body: JSON object. Supports creating presets
for either a single device or a device group, based on `deviceID` or `deviceGroupID`. If
`eventParameters` is empty, it is stored as `{}`.

post.summary: Copies an event preset to another device.
post.description:
Copies the existing preset to the destination device after validating read access to the source preset and
write access to the destination device.

parameters.name: eventPresetID
parameters.description: The ID of the source event preset.

parameters.name: newDeviceID
parameters.description: The ID of the destination device.

get.summary: Gets the event status list.
get.description: Returns the supported event statuses.

post.summary: Gets the event type list.
post.description: Request body: JSON object with the agent type name.

post.summary: Creates a file record.
post.description:
Request body: JSON object. Accepts either
`deviceSerial` or `deviceName`. On success, it returns the created file
with a signed upload URL in `fileLocation`.

delete.description: Deletes the file record and its backing file content when available.

parameters.name: deviceID
parameters.description: The ID of the device that owns the file.

parameters.name: fileID
parameters.description: The ID of the file to delete.

post.summary: Creates a temporary file record and signed upload URL.
post.description:
Request body: JSON object. This endpoint does not create a database file record.
It returns a signed upload URL, and the response payload is shaped like
response with `fileID = 0`.

get.summary: Gets a file by ID.
get.description: Returns the file with a download location. Download behavior may vary by environment.

parameters.description: The ID of the file to retrieve.

post.summary: Marks a file upload as successful.
post.description: Marks the file upload as successful.

parameters.name: fileID
parameters.description: The ID of the uploaded file.

owned by the same user.

parameters.description: The ID of the user group to update.

parameters.description: The ID of the user group to delete.

Returns the users in the group with availability details.

post.description:
Request body: JSON object. This endpoint uses `value` as the group
name, sanitizes it to alphanumeric characters and spaces, truncates it to 100 characters, and rejects
duplicate group names for the same user.

`WPA-PSK`, `WPA-EAP`, or `WPA-PSK-SHA256`, it defaults to `WPA-PSK`.
